♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: The Moon has now shifted into Taurus in your 2nd house, moving you from yesterday’s fiery urgency into a steadier, more grounded tone. With the Sun and Mercury retrograde together in Virgo in your 6th house, today is about refining how you use your time, energy, and skills. Mars in Cancer activates your 4th house, stirring things at home or within your emotional base, while Jupiter in Cancer continues to expand that same inner territory. Rahu in Pisces and Ketu in Virgo keep a quiet pressure on your work–rest balance and your spiritual life.

💼 Career: The lunar focus on your 2nd house turns your attention toward what you’re actually being paid for versus what you are quietly giving away. Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 6th can bring reviews of duties, schedules, or an old work conversation resurfacing. This is a useful day to correct errors, revisit a process, or re-negotiate a small but important detail in your routine. Mars in your 4th may pull you to handle a domestic matter during work hours; if you’re juggling, be clear about what absolutely must get done and what can slide.

❤️ Love: With the Moon in a Venus-ruled sign and Mars stirring the home sector, relationship themes today center on comfort, security, and how safe you feel emotionally. In existing partnerships, practical discussions about living arrangements, shared chores, or family decisions may dominate. Instead of pushing for instant agreement, aim for workable compromises that respect both people’s rhythms. If single, you may feel drawn to someone whose presence feels steady rather than dramatic; pay attention to who makes your nervous system relax.

💰 Money: Taurus Moon in your 2nd house is a classic transit for taking stock of your material world: earnings, expenses, your relationship to possessions. It’s a good day to clean out a drawer or closet, list something for sale, or finally cancel what you don’t use. Sun–Mercury retrograde in the 6th supports revisiting contracts, rate structures, or invoicing methods. Avoid impulsive comfort purchases—ask whether the item will genuinely be used over the next six months.

🧘 Advice: Let your fire express itself through patient, tangible improvements rather than big pushes. Small, grounded actions will stabilize the momentum you’ve been building.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you treat your efforts as valuable, the world gets clearer signals about how to treat you.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through Taurus and your 1st house today, putting your body, mood, and personal choices at center stage. This is your lunar reset: you’re more aware of your needs and less willing to ignore them. The Sun with Mercury retrograde in Virgo energises your 5th house, waking up creativity, romance, and your desire to express yourself differently. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer activate your 3rd house, making your mind busy and your local environment more demanding.

💼 Career: This is a good day to be visibly present rather than hiding behind the scenes. You may be asked for your opinion or to take the lead on something that needs a calm, consistent hand. The 5th-house Sun–Mercury retrograde favours revisiting an old idea, design, pitch, or piece of content that can be refreshed and used again. Discussions around children, education, or creative projects could intersect with your work decisions. Try not to overload your schedule with errands; prioritize one or two important conversations instead.

❤️ Love: With the Moon in your own sign, you feel more sensitive to how others respond to your needs. Venus, your ruler, is still highlighting relational themes this month, but today the emphasis is on what genuinely pleases you, not just what keeps the peace. In relationships, you might want more affection or reassurance; say that plainly rather than hinting. If single, you’re magnetic but may also be more selective—someone from your recent past or a familiar environment could reappear or feel newly appealing.

💰 Money: The Taurus Moon tends to stabilize finances when you cooperate with it. Instead of chasing something new, look at how to better use what you already own—skills, tools, contacts. The Virgo 5th house activation can bring spending related to hobbies, events, or children; Mercury retrograde suggests revisiting earlier plans or tickets rather than impulsively booking fresh ones. If you’ve lent money or favors in the past, this transit can prompt you to check where reciprocity is due.

🧘 Advice: Put your body back into the equation—comfort, rest, and simple pleasures are signals, not luxuries. When you feel settled, decisions become obvious.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Honouring what you truly enjoy is not selfish; it’s how your life starts to feel like it belongs to you.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Taurus in your 12th house, your normally quick mind turns inward. You may feel reflective, dreamier, or slightly withdrawn, even if life is busy around you. Your ruler Mercury retrograde travels with the Sun in Virgo through your 4th house, stirring memories, family conversations, and questions about where and with whom you feel at home. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer energise your 2nd house of resources, keeping practical concerns close to the surface.

💼 Career: This is more of a behind-the-scenes day than a front-stage one. You may be productive when working alone, finishing something that doesn’t need a lot of interaction, or quietly correcting older work. Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 4th can bring thoughts about working from home, relocating, or altering your workspace. An old professional contact connected to real estate, property, or family businesses might resurface. Give yourself a bit more buffer time in your schedule; your energy may dip suddenly and then return.

❤️ Love: The 12th-house Moon can make you nostalgic or more attuned to subtle signals. You may think about past partners or old relational patterns with unusual clarity. In current relationships, gentle, private moments—cooking together, talking in a quiet corner, or sharing something personal—are more nourishing than public plans. If single, you could feel drawn toward someone who feels strangely familiar or karmic; take your time before defining what the connection is.

💰 Money: With Mars and Jupiter in your 2nd house, money decisions carry extra charge. There may be opportunities to increase income through initiative—asking for overdue payments, finishing a monetizable project, or exploring a side skill—but also a risk of overreaching. The Taurus Moon advises conservative, patient steps. Check for recurring expenses linked to your home or digital services that no longer match your reality.

🧘 Advice: Don’t fight the quieter mood. Solitude and stillness can help you connect dots that constant motion never lets you see.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop filling every silence with noise, your own deeper guidance finally has room to speak.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, travels through Taurus in your 11th house, turning your focus toward friends, networks, and long-term hopes. With Mars and Jupiter both in Cancer in your 1st house, your personal drive and visibility are heightened—you’re more assertive than usual, even if gently. Sun–Mercury retrograde in Virgo light up your 3rd house, emphasizing communication, learning, and the way you move through your immediate environment.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for collaborative work, group projects, and strategic planning. You’re well-placed to bring people together around a shared goal, especially if it has a practical Virgo flavor—improving systems, documentation, or communications. Mercury retrograde suggests that a previous project, proposal, or contact from earlier in the year could come back with new relevance. Mars/Jupiter in your sign can push you to take on too much; delegate where possible and be realistic about timing.

❤️ Love: Social circles, extended family, and community activities may play a noticeable role in your relationship life today. For partnered Cancers, events with friends or group plans can reveal how well your relationship flows in a wider context; notice where you feel proud to stand side by side and where friction appears. If single, introductions via friends, siblings, or online communities are favored. Just pace emotional sharing—Mars in your sign can make you more reactive if someone doesn’t respond as quickly as you’d like.

💰 Money: The 11th house also connects to long-range income and goals. This Moon is excellent for reviewing savings plans, retirement ideas, or collective financial initiatives. Virgo’s 3rd-house influence may bring paperwork, contracts, or negotiations that need a second look; Mercury retrograde supports spotting details that were missed before. Be moderately cautious with any scheme that feels like “easy money through a group”—ask the practical questions before agreeing.

🧘 Advice: Use your current courage to step into roles and spaces that once felt intimidating, but let steady Taurus energy keep your decisions grounded.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your care for others becomes more powerful when it’s guided by a clear vision of where you’re all heading.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon sits high in your chart in the 10th house, spotlighting your public life, reputation, and responsibilities. With the Sun—your ruler—together with Mercury retrograde in Virgo in your 2nd house, there’s a parallel focus on income, values, and how you define success. Mars and Jupiter stirring your 12th house add a subtle, restless undercurrent in the background: unspoken ambitions, private worries, or a desire to retreat.

💼 Career: Visibility is strong today. You may be noticed for your reliability, your aesthetic sense, or the tangible results of your efforts. The Taurus Moon supports slow, solid progress: think consistency over spectacle. Sun–Mercury retrograde in the 2nd house makes this a good day to revisit salary discussions, pricing of your services, or the way you present your value. An older project, client, or role could return for reconsideration. Avoid letting hidden frustrations from the 12th house leak out as impatience with colleagues—channel that energy into quiet problem-solving.

❤️ Love: Because career and practical matters are loud, you may feel slightly distant or preoccupied in relationships unless you consciously make space. In existing partnerships, shared goals about money, lifestyle, or long-term security can be discussed more concretely. If single, you might feel drawn toward people you meet through work or professional spaces; pay attention to how they treat others in those settings, not just how they treat you.

💰 Money: This is one of your more grounded financial days. The combination of Taurus Moon and Virgo Sun emphasizes realistic budgeting, simple savings moves, and correcting past oversights. Mercury retrograde suggests checking statements, subscriptions, or old agreements. You may also rethink whether certain status purchases actually reflect your true values or just an old image of who you thought you had to be.

🧘 Advice: Let your definition of success mature. When your outer achievements match your inner priorities, you don’t have to keep performing for approval.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Real confidence grows quieter as it deepens; it shows in your choices more than in your announcements.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon moves through your 9th house, inviting a broader perspective: learning, belief systems, and plans that stretch beyond your usual horizon. Meanwhile the Sun and Mercury retrograde in Virgo highlight your 1st house, sharpening self-awareness and putting your identity and direction under review. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer activate your 11th house of friendships and future plans, adding social and aspirational currents.

💼 Career: Today is excellent for stepping back from the small tasks to see the bigger map of where you’re going. Sun–Mercury retrograde in your sign favor editing, rebranding, or recalibrating your professional image. You might revisit an old qualification, training, or mentor connection as the 9th house is lit by the Moon. Meetings with teams or communities can help you test new ideas about your path, but give yourself time before making irreversible commitments.

❤️ Love: With so much emphasis on your own sign, you may be doing a lot of internal sorting about what you really want from relationships. The 9th-house Moon supports honest, philosophical conversations with a partner: where your lives are heading, what you each believe about commitment, freedom, and growth. If single, you could feel drawn to people from different cultures, backgrounds, or belief systems, or reconnect with someone you met through study or travel.

💰 Money: Financially, this is more of a planning and learning day than a high-action one. The 9th house favors research on investments, taxes, or long-range financial education. Mercury retrograde in your 1st suggests revisiting previous money decisions with wiser eyes rather than judging yourself; adjust what needs adjusting. Group-related expenses or income (via the 11th house) may come up—subscriptions, memberships, or collaborative ventures can be pruned or clarified.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to be in revision mode. You’re allowed to outgrow old versions of yourself and choose a direction that fits who you are now.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Self-improvement becomes self-respect the moment you stop fixing yourself to be acceptable and start refining yourself to be authentic.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus moves through your 8th house, emphasizing shared resources, emotional depth, and psychological undercurrents. The Sun with Mercury retrograde in Virgo is tucked into your 12th house, making this a more introspective, behind-the-scenes period than usual. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer energise your 10th house, keeping career ambitions humming even as part of you wants to retreat and process.

💼 Career: Outwardly, you may appear competent and engaged, but internally you’re likely reviewing whether your current path fits your deeper needs. Hidden dynamics at work—unspoken expectations, old power structures, or subtle alliances—can come into sharper focus. Use the 8th-house Moon to examine contracts, long-term obligations, and where you share responsibility or credit. Sun–Mercury retrograde in the 12th suggests that an old workplace story or pattern is ripe for closure; you might understand now what you couldn’t before.

❤️ Love: Emotional layers are thicker today. You may feel the urge to talk about topics usually left in the shadows: fears, vulnerabilities, or how you share resources and responsibilities in partnership. Done gently, this can deepen intimacy. If tensions arise, avoid jumping to conclusions; the 12th-house Sun means you’re still piecing together the full picture. If single, you might feel drawn to intense, private connections or someone who feels like they “see through you.” Check whether the bond feels empowering or draining.

💰 Money: The 8th house rules shared money, debts, inheritances, and long-term financial entanglements. This is a powerful day for small but meaningful steps: consolidating information about loans, clarifying who pays what in a household, or reading the fine print on a policy. With Mars/Jupiter in your 10th, career decisions may have larger-than-usual financial consequences; plan carefully rather than acting from momentary frustration or excitement.

🧘 Advice: Make room for your private processing even if the outer world demands performance. Insight arrives when you stop rushing to have everything look balanced.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The partnerships that truly support you are the ones where your hidden truths don’t have to stay hidden.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon travels through your 7th house of one-to-one relationships, bringing other people’s needs and responses to the forefront. Mars, your traditional ruler, together with Jupiter in Cancer light up your 9th house, stirring a desire for meaning, exploration, and mental or spiritual expansion. Sun–Mercury retrograde in Virgo activate your 11th house, turning your attention to friends, communities, and long-term hopes.

💼 Career: Collaborations, client relationships, and key alliances are highlighted. The 7th-house Moon makes it easier to see where cooperation flows and where it feels heavy. This is a constructive time to refine agreements: timelines, responsibilities, and expectations in shared projects. Sun–Mercury retrograde in the 11th supports reconnecting with an old colleague, mentor, or group that may now play a new role. International, educational, or legal matters linked to work (9th house) can move forward through patient effort rather than force.

❤️ Love: Today’s astro emphasizes the quality of your close bonds. In partnerships, you may feel more aware of how reliable and grounded the other person feels. Conversations about the future—travel, study, relocating, or what you’re building together—can arise naturally. If single, you’re likely to notice people who bring a sense of both stability (Taurus Moon) and inspiration (Cancer 9th) into your life. Someone from your wider social circle could suddenly shift into a more intimate role.

💰 Money: Shared finances and long-range plans intersect now. Income connected to partners, clients, or collaborations may require review—are the arrangements fair, sustainable, and clearly documented? Mercury retrograde suggests you double-check group-related financial commitments: memberships, subscriptions, or ventures with friends. The 9th-house emphasis favors spending on education, travel, or spiritual growth if it’s done within a realistic budget.

🧘 Advice: Let trusted others reflect parts of you that are hard to see alone, but keep your authority over final choices.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The right partnership doesn’t dilute your power—it helps you aim it more precisely.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus moves through your 6th house, emphasizing health habits, work routines, and the way you manage everyday obligations. Your ruler Jupiter, together with Mars, energises Cancer in your 8th house, making deeper emotional and financial themes quietly active. Sun–Mercury retrograde in Virgo sit at the top of your chart in the 10th house, highlighting career reputation and long-term direction.

💼 Career: The focus is on how your daily efforts support—or undermine—your bigger ambitions. You may be asked to review procedures, schedules, or responsibilities at work. Mercury retrograde in the 10th can bring back an old role, client, or project for reconsideration, or prompt you to re-evaluate your public image. The Taurus Moon favors practical, incremental improvements: streamline one process, organise a workspace, or establish a realistic timeline for a significant goal.

❤️ Love: Because your attention is pulled toward work and practicalities, relationships may need you to show care in concrete ways: keeping promises, being on time, following through on shared tasks. In existing partnerships, discussions about how you divide labor, both emotional and practical, could surface. If single, you might notice attraction in work or service environments—someone whose competence and consistency stand out.

💰 Money: The 8th-house activation suggests that joint finances, loans, taxes, or shared investments may be on your mind. This is not necessarily a crisis transit; it’s an opportunity to become more conscious of long-range entanglements. The 6th-house Moon supports looking at how daily habits influence your money: routine spending, small leaks, or ways to make income steadier. You might benefit from revisiting older financial plans or documents with fresh eyes.

🧘 Advice: Aim for sustainable progress instead of heroic sprints. When your everyday systems work, your natural optimism has something to stand on.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Big horizons become reachable when you start respecting the small steps that get you there.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon lights up your 5th house of creativity, joy, and self-expression, softening your normally serious tone and inviting pleasure with purpose. Saturn, your ruler, continues its sobering lessons in Pisces in your 3rd house, but today that’s balanced by a more playful current. Sun–Mercury retrograde in Virgo energise your 9th house, pulling your thoughts toward study, travel, or widening your understanding of life. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer across the way in your 7th house highlight important relationships.

💼 Career: This is a favorable day for showcasing talent and adding a bit of style or warmth to your work. Presentations, creative solutions, and mentorship roles are supported. With Sun–Mercury retrograde in the 9th, you might revisit an old course, certification, or long-distance opportunity, or reconnect with someone from another city or culture who influences your path. Partnerships in business may be especially active—discussing strategy, contracts, or mutual expectations.

❤️ Love: Romance and affection are gently highlighted. The 5th-house Moon can make you more open to experiencing simple joys with a partner or loved ones: shared meals, art, music, or time with children. If there have been heavier conversations lately, today is good for reconnecting through something enjoyable rather than more analysis. Single Capricorns may feel drawn to someone who combines emotional warmth (Cancer 7th) with grounded sensuality (Taurus Moon); an old flame could reappear through online or distant channels.

💰 Money: Financially, this is a day to consider investments of both money and energy into what brings you longer-term satisfaction—creative projects, education, or experiences that broaden your skills. Mercury retrograde in the 9th suggests double-checking travel bookings, tuition agreements, or legal documents. Be mindful of spending on entertainment or children; choose quality over quantity.

🧘 Advice: Allow yourself to enjoy being in the story, not just holding it together. Joy is not a distraction from responsibility—it’s part of what makes it sustainable.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you let delight share the stage with duty, your efforts gain a glow that hard work alone can’t create.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus travels through your 4th house, drawing attention to home, family, and your inner emotional climate. Saturn in Pisces in your 2nd house continues its longer-term restructuring of finances and self-worth, while Sun–Mercury retrograde in Virgo emphasize your 8th house of shared resources and deeper psychological material. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer energise your 6th house, keeping daily tasks and health routines quite active.

💼 Career: While practical obligations are many, your emotional base needs tending if you want to stay effective. Work matters may involve confidential information, shared budgets, or complex collaborations (8th house themes). Mercury retrograde suggests previous agreements or financial discussions re-emerging for revision. You might work from home, think about relocating, or subtly rearrange your work–life balance today. Take care not to make hasty decisions about money or roles while feeling emotionally stirred.

❤️ Love: Home and vulnerability are central themes. In existing relationships, topics like living arrangements, emotional safety, and how you support each other in everyday stress are likely to surface. The Taurus Moon invites you to create tangible comfort—cooking together, rearranging a space, or simply being present without distraction. If single, you might feel less socially extroverted and more selective; nurturing connections that feel gentle and non-dramatic can be especially healing now.

💰 Money: The 2nd–8th house axis is lit up, making this a key period for honest financial assessment. Shared bills, joint accounts, inheritances, or loans could need attention. Mercury retrograde helps you spot clauses, small print, or misunderstandings that benefit from clarification. The Taurus Moon in your 4th favors thinking about longer-term security: savings goals tied to housing, family, or creating a stable base. Avoid letting temporary emotions drive permanent financial decisions.

🧘 Advice: Strengthen your foundation before stretching further. When your inner and home life feel steadier, you can handle external changes with much more ease.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The freedom you crave in the world starts with feeling safe where you lay your head.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus moves through your 3rd house of communication, short journeys, and mental habits, giving your thoughts a more measured, practical tone. Saturn in Pisces in your 1st house continues to refine your identity and boundaries. Sun–Mercury retrograde in Virgo highlight your 7th house of partnerships, bringing relationships and agreements into review. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer energise your 5th house, stirring creativity, playfulness, and a desire to be seen.

💼 Career: Today favors thoughtful conversations, planning, and follow-ups. You may revisit an old partnership, client relationship, or contract under the Sun–Mercury retrograde influence in your 7th. It’s a strong day for renegotiating terms, checking understanding, and clarifying expectations. The Taurus Moon in the 3rd supports careful wording and a calm, diplomatic tone. Creative tasks and projects that involve writing, design, or teaching are well-aspected, especially if they allow you to build on something you’ve already started.

❤️ Love: Relationships are very much in focus. With the Sun opposite your sign and the Moon emphasizing communication, you’re invited to listen as much as you speak. In ongoing partnerships, old discussions may resurface—not to repeat old cycles, but so they can finally be handled with more maturity and clarity. If tensions arise, ground the conversation in specific examples rather than vague feelings. Single Pisces may reconnect with someone from their past or encounter an intriguing person in familiar surroundings—neighborhood, commute, or online spaces you already frequent.

💰 Money: Financial conversations with partners, family members, or collaborators can be productive today if you keep them factual. The 3rd-house Moon helps you organize information—spreadsheets, lists, or simple breakdowns of who covers what. Mercury retrograde warns against rushing into new agreements; instead, refine existing ones. Pleasure-related spending (5th house) may beckon; choose experiences or tools that genuinely nourish your creativity rather than quick distractions.

🧘 Advice: Let clarity be an act of kindness—to yourself and others. When you say what you mean in simple, grounded language, relationships become less confusing.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your sensitivity becomes a strength when it’s paired with clear words and steady boundaries.
